title: 第013章 漩涡
content_zh:
韩信给与刘长的感觉，酷似吕后，却有稍稍的不同。
冷漠，孤寂，惆怅，或者说，整个时代给刘长的感觉都是如此，除了那个大大咧咧的父亲，还有那一群傻乎乎的哥哥们，其他人的脸上，总是散不去的悲凉，在见不到半点绿色的皇宫里，灰白的建筑之上，让人找不到半点的快乐。
战争带来的苦难是巨大的，而这种苦难并没有因为战争而结束而有所好转，整个华夏都在战后默默舔舐着伤口，为那些在苦难中逝世以及正在遭受苦难的人而落泪。
在刘邦之前，华夏已经经历了长达两百多年的战争，在这两百多年的时间里，光是有记录的战死的士卒，就已经接近三百万人。每一个战死的士卒身后，都是一个破碎的家庭，哭泣的父母，思念良人的妻，失去了父亲的孩子。
而因为战争的余波而引起的灾害，更是不知夺走了多少人的性命。
在后世看起来一个个冰冷的数字，在那时也曾是一个个活着的生命。
战争已经过去了，但是各地那些富裕的耕地上长满了荒草。坐在门口等待着孩子的父母已经不在了，可那些身强力壮的一家主梁却依旧没有回来。
无论是韩信，或吕后，想必他们的愁苦与这些是无关的，但是绝不能说这样的时代就没有影响到活在这个时代里的众生。
“师父，你要怎么教我呢？是不是要带我去兵营？”
刘长激动的坐在韩信的面前，没有半点的不安或者拘束。
这倒让韩信有些惊讶。
韩信在大展才华之后，几乎就没有人敢这么跟他随意了，刘邦是唯一一个敢挖苦他，敢跟他开玩笑的。樊哙这种猛汉只敢对他行跪拜礼，都不敢抬头看他一眼，萧何这样的功臣排名第一跟他说话都是小心翼翼的，不敢怠慢，至于周勃，陈平，绛灌，随路，曹参，夏侯婴之流，他压根就不放在眼里。
韩信瞥了他一眼，方才说道：“我不能去军营。”
“那要怎么教呢？”
“要学兵法，读书是没有用的，得要从最基础的东西开始学习。”
“好嘞，那您教吧！”
刘长拿起了笔和无比珍贵的纸，这还是他有史以来第一次如此认真的听讲，毕竟这是他感兴趣的课程，无论是哪个男人，心里都装着一个军旅梦，更何况是在古代，那种率领千军万马攻城略地的诱惑，是谁都无法抵挡的。
“五个甲士年食粟150石，若是你要带着两万甲士出征，预计作战时间为两年，你得要准备多少粮食呢？”
“嗯？？？”
刘长瞪大了双眼，这是兵法还是数学？

而且这也太简单了吧。
“120万石。”
刘长不假思索的说出了答案，韩信脸上显然有了一丝惊讶，虽说这个时代已经有了乘法表，懂数学的人分分钟也能算出来，可是刘长这个年纪，能如此迅速的算出来，还是不错的，这显然跟韩信所以为的不学无术的公子还是有些出入的。
“还不错...”
“这就是兵法？？”
“这是兵法的一部分，不过，你的答案是错的，要准备200万石。”
“不可能，120万是对的。”
“行军途中一定会造成粮食的浪费，保不准会发生意外，战期也可能会拖延，所以无论什么时候，准备的粮食都要远远大于作战所必需的粮食。”
刘长恍然大悟，这说的倒是很有道理，虽然还是简单了一些。
接下来，韩信所教授的知识都是基础中的基础，根本就没有刘长所想的那种能打败项羽的高深战术，虽说只是些基础知识，但讲课的人毕竟是韩信，韩信在讲述过程中常常举例，举出的例子还都是他自己的亲身经历。
刘长就当作听故事，听的是格外入迷。
“师父，您当初是怎么打败项羽的？给我说说呗，项羽那么猛的一个人，您是怎么将他打败的？”
在休息的时候，刘长就缠着韩信，非让他给自己讲故事，韩信在讲课的时候虽然偶尔举例，可要他自己详细的去说，他却不愿意，他仿佛很不愿意回忆当初的事情，脸上满是不悦，任由刘长撒泼打滚，也是不说。
韩信的性格跟刘长真的是截然相反，水火不容，韩信是一个严肃，死板的人，因为长期的带兵经历，他治人以严，不喜欢打闹喧哗，而刘长呢，又是个活宝性子，一刻也不能安静下来，很是闹腾。
韩信非常非常非常不喜欢这个小徒弟，在刘长拿着自己的佩剑四处叫嚷的时候，他终于忍不住了，黑着脸，让家奴将这货给揪了出去，要他明天再来。
刘长倒是很喜欢韩信，他觉得这个忧郁的大叔有种莫名的魅力，讲的课也很有意思，满怀期待的回了皇宫。
刚刚回到了皇宫，还没来得及跟阿母吹嘘自己今天的表现，刘长就被带到了刘邦的面前。
刘邦正在专心的批阅着什么，刘长踮起脚尖，偷看了几眼。
刘邦这才将竹简收起来，侧着头，打量着刘长。
“从韩信那里回来了？”

“嗯。”
“学的怎么样？”
“很好，老师非常的开心，对我也非常的满意。”
“读了兵法？还是他亲自教你？”
“老师亲自教我。”
“他有没有问你的情况？”
“啊？”
“就是问你在皇宫里过的怎么样啊，或者问你皇宫里的情况之类的。”
“没有。”
“那他有没有提起你母亲，或者你几个兄长？”
“没有。”
“嗯，朕问你的这些话，不许告诉任何人，否则...朕就砸了你的做的纺车。”
“....知道了。”
刘长虽然皮，可对刘邦还是有一定畏惧的，他知道刘邦向来是说到做到的，因此在见到母亲之后，也没有将刘邦询问的事情告诉她。不过，令人困惑的是，吕后好像也忽然对他跟韩信学习的事情有了兴趣。
甚至，吕后也问了一模一样的问题。
“他有没有询问皇宫里的情况？”
“他有没有问我或者你大哥？”
吕后所说的大哥，是刘盈。吕后似乎只承认自己有两个儿子，平日里跟刘长说起其他皇子的时候，都是直呼其名，只有说刘盈的时候，才会说你的大哥，对刘盈也是这样，只有谈到刘长的时候会说你的弟弟。
当然，在谈话的最后，吕后也是跟刘邦一样的对刘长进行了威胁和恐吓。
“要是你说出去，以后就不给你吃牛肉了。”

只能说，父母都是抓住了刘长的死穴，令他无法在外肆意的胡说八道。刘长自己只怕都没有意识到，他已经陷入了一场非常恐怖的政治漩涡，任何人都不敢松懈，大家都面临着相同的威胁。
刘长依旧忙着自己的事情，听闻刘长在做纺车，刘盈还来了一次，笑呵呵的鼓励了刘长一番，说他的行为是值得其他皇子们学习的。在儒学没有兴起，或者说没有变质的汉初时期，没有人对发明和机器怀着痛恨之心。
秦汉都很鼓励发明创造，在“暴秦”，若是你能发明出一个有利于国家的新机器，那你是可以升爵的。我大汉当然不会抄袭“暴秦”，在我大汉，你若是能发明出有用的东西，是可以得到奖励的，奖励通常是升你的爵位。看得出，我大汉绝对没有半点抄袭“暴秦”的行为。
因此，在这个时代，搞发明创造不算是不学无术，刘盈也很支持刘长的想法。
刘长最初不愿意将这件事告诉刘盈，主要原因是他不想听刘盈讲大道理。
刘盈还是讲了一番大道理，从发明创造的重要性谈到了孝道，又说起了民间的穿衣问题，从道家思想说到了儒家思想，又从儒家思想说到了法家思想，就连墨家也有提及。
只是，刘长听不懂他那些长篇大论，只是傻乎乎的点着头。
事实证明，大哥还是靠谱的，虽然给与刘长一定的精神折磨，可在离开之前，他令人带回了刘长所需要的一切工具以及原料。刘恒刘如意他们搞不定的东西，刘盈是完全可以搞定的。
刘长喜出望外，一口一个大哥，说的刘盈美滋滋的仰起了头。
ps：讲明几点，首先，为了能让刘邦等人都出场，老狼特意增加了一些皇子们的年龄，毕竟这些设定都是为了剧情而服务，希望大家能理解。
另外，关于主角的史盲问题，我自己是个学历史的，为了能写好一个理工类的主角，我问了很多已经工作的，符合主角穿越前人设的朋友。他们大多都知道刘邦，吕后，韩信等人，知道刘彻，但是不知道刘恒，我问了大概十几个朋友，只有两个是知道刘恒是汉文帝的。
其实老狼不太喜欢大家争执这些东西，希望大家能将注意力放在剧情上，多谈论剧情，而不是这些设定和属性上，希望大家能多给出一些自己的想法，对剧情的理解和意见，这会对老狼接下来的创作很有帮助。
content_en:
Han Xin gave Liu Chang a feeling that he was very similar to Empress Lu, but slightly different.
Indifference, loneliness, melancholy, or in other words, this is how Liu Chang felt throughout the entire era. Except for his careless father and the group of silly brothers, there was always a lingering sadness on the faces of the others. In the palace with no green at all, on the gray buildings, people could not find any happiness at all.
The suffering caused by the war was huge, and this suffering did not get better because the war ended. The whole of China silently licked its wounds after the war, weeping for those who died in the suffering and those who are suffering.
Before Liu Bang, China had experienced more than two hundred years of war. During these two hundred years, the number of recorded soldiers killed in battle alone was close to three million. Behind every soldier who died in battle is a broken family, crying parents, wives who miss their husbands, and children who have lost their fathers.
And the disasters caused by the aftermath of the war claimed countless lives.
Numbers that may seem cold to later generations were once living beings at that time.
The war is over, but the rich farmlands everywhere are covered with weeds. The parents sitting at the door waiting for their children are no longer here, but the able-bodied mainstay of the family still haven't come back.
Whether it is Han Xin or Empress Lu, their sorrows must have nothing to do with these, but it cannot be said that such an era has not affected all living beings living in this era.
"Master, how are you going to teach me? Do you want to take me to the barracks?"
Liu Chang sat excitedly in front of Han Xin, without any uneasiness or restraint.
This surprised Han Xin.
After Han Xin showed his talents, almost no one dared to be so casual with him. Liu Bang was the only one who dared to ridicule him and joke with him. A fierce man like Fan Kuai only dared to kneel down and bow to him without even daring to look up at him. A hero like Xiao He, who was ranked number one, was very careful when talking to him and did not dare to neglect. As for Zhou Bo, Chen Ping, Jiang Guan, Sui Lu, Cao Shen, Xia Hou Ying and others, he didn't pay attention at all.
Han Xin glanced at him and said, "I can't go to the military camp."
"Then how to teach?"
"If you want to learn the art of war, it's useless to study. You have to start learning from the most basic things."
"Okay, then you can teach me!"
Liu Chang picked up a pen and extremely precious paper. This was the first time in his history that he listened so carefully. After all, this was a course he was interested in. No matter which man he was, he always had a military dream in his heart. What's more, in ancient times, no one could resist the temptation of leading thousands of troops to attack cities and conquer territories.
"Five soldiers eat 150 shi of millet per year. If you are going to go on an expedition with 20,000 soldiers, and the estimated combat time is two years, how much food do you have to prepare?"
"Huh???"
Liu Chang's eyes widened. Is this the art of war or mathematics?
And this is too simple.
"1.2 million stones."
Liu Chang said the answer without thinking, and there was obviously a trace of surprise on Han Xin's face. Although there are already multiplication tables in this era, and people who know mathematics can calculate it in minutes, it is still good for Liu Chang to be able to calculate it so quickly at his age. This is obviously different from what Han Xin thought of him as an ignorant young man.
"Not bad..."
"This is the art of war??"
"This is part of the art of war. However, your answer is wrong. You need to prepare 2 million stones."
"No way, 1.2 million is right."
"There will definitely be a waste of food during the march, accidents are guaranteed, and the war may be delayed. Therefore, at any time, the food prepared must be far greater than what is necessary for the battle."
Liu Chang suddenly realized that what he said made sense, although it was still a bit simple..
Next, the knowledge Han Xin taught was all the basics. There was no advanced tactics that Liu Chang thought could defeat Xiang Yu. Although it was just basic knowledge, the lecturer was Han Xin after all. Han Xin often gave examples during the lecture, and the examples he gave were all from his own personal experience.
Liu Chang just listened to the story and was particularly fascinated by it.
"Master, how did you defeat Xiang Yu? Tell me, Xiang Yu is such a fierce person, how did you defeat him?"
During the break, Liu Chang pestered Han Xin and insisted on telling him stories. Although Han Xin occasionally gave examples during the lecture, he was unwilling to explain it in detail. He seemed to be very unwilling to recall what happened at the beginning. His face was full of displeasure, and he allowed Liu Chang to wallow and talk, but he did not say anything.
Han Xin's personality is completely opposite to that of Liu Chang. They are incompatible with each other. Han Xin is a serious and rigid person. Because of his long experience in leading troops, he treats people with strict discipline and does not like to fight and make noise. Liu Chang, on the other hand, has a lively temper and cannot calm down for a moment. He is very noisy.
Han Xin disliked this little apprentice very, very, very much. When Liu Chang shouted around with his sword, he finally couldn't help it anymore. With a dark face, he asked his slaves to take the guy out and ask him to come back tomorrow.
Liu Chang liked Han Xin very much. He felt that this melancholic uncle had an inexplicable charm and the lectures he gave were very interesting. He returned to the palace with great expectations.
Just after returning to the palace, before he could brag to his mother about his performance today, Liu Chang was brought to Liu Bang.
Liu Bang was concentrating on reviewing something. Liu Chang stood on tiptoes and took a few peeks.
Liu Bang then put away the bamboo slips, tilted his head, and looked at Liu Chang.
"Back from Han Xin?"
"Yeah."
"How are you studying?"
"Very good. The teacher is very happy and very satisfied with me."
"Did you read the Art of War? Or did he teach you personally?"
"The teacher taught me personally."
"Did he ask about you?"
"Huh?"
"I just want to ask you how your life is in the palace, or ask you about the situation in the palace."
"No."
"Then did he mention your mother or your brothers?"
"No."
"Well, you are not allowed to tell anyone what I asked you, otherwise... I will smash the spinning wheel you made."
".... Got it."
Although Liu Chang was naughty, he still had a certain fear of Liu Bang. He knew that Liu Bang always kept his word, so after meeting his mother, he did not tell her what Liu Bang asked about. However, what is puzzling is that Queen Lu seemed to suddenly be interested in what he was learning from Han Xin.
Even Queen Lu asked the exact same question.
"Did he ask about the situation in the palace?"
"Did he ask me or your eldest brother?"
The eldest brother Empress Lu mentioned was Liu Ying. Queen Lu seems to only admit that she has two sons. When talking about other princes with Liu Chang, she always calls them by their first names. Only when talking about Liu Ying, she will say your eldest brother. The same is true for Liu Ying. Only when talking about Liu Chang, she will say your younger brother.
Of course, at the end of the conversation, Empress Lu also threatened and intimidated Liu Chang just like Liu Bang.
"If you tell me, I won't feed you beef in the future."
It can only be said that his parents have grasped Liu Chang's weak point, preventing him from talking nonsense outside. Liu Chang himself may not even realize that he has fallen into a very terrifying political whirlpool. No one dares to relax, and everyone is facing the same threat.
Liu Chang was still busy with his own affairs. Hearing that Liu Chang was making a spinning wheel, Liu Ying came over once more and encouraged Liu Chang with a smile, saying that his behavior was worth learning from other princes. In the early Han period when Confucianism did not rise or change,No one hates inventions and machines.
Both Qin and Han Dynasties encouraged invention and creation. In "Bao Qin", if you can invent a new machine that is beneficial to the country, then you can be promoted. Of course, I, the Han Dynasty, will not copy "Bao Qin". In my Han Dynasty, if you can invent something useful, you can get rewards, and the reward is usually an upgrade to your title. It can be seen that I, a big man, definitely did not plagiarize the "Bao Qin" behavior at all.
Therefore, in this era, making inventions and creations is not considered unskilled, and Liu Ying also supports Liu Chang's ideas.
Liu Chang was initially reluctant to tell Liu Ying about this, mainly because he didn't want to listen to Liu Ying's rationale.
Liu Ying still talked about a lot of truth, starting from the importance of invention and creation to filial piety, and talking about the issue of clothing among the people, from Taoism to Confucianism, and from Confucianism to Legalism, even Mohism was mentioned.
However, Liu Chang couldn't understand his long speech and just nodded stupidly.
Facts have proved that the eldest brother is still reliable. Although he gave Liu Chang a certain amount of mental torture, before leaving, he brought back all the tools and raw materials Liu Chang needed. What Liu Heng, Liu Ruyi and the others couldn't handle, Liu Ying could definitely handle.
Liu Chang was overjoyed, and he spoke like a big brother. Liu Ying raised her head in joy.
ps: Let me explain a few points. First of all, in order to allow Liu Bang and others to appear, Lao Lang deliberately increased the ages of some princes. After all, these settings are for the sake of the plot. I hope everyone can understand.
In addition, regarding the protagonist’s historical illiteracy, I am a history student. In order to write a science and engineering protagonist, I asked many friends who are already working and who fit the protagonist’s pre-travel personality. Most of them know Liu Bang, Empress Lu, Han Xin and others, and they know Liu Che, but they don't know Liu Heng. I asked about a dozen friends, and only two knew that Liu Heng was Emperor Wen of Han.
In fact, Lao Lang doesn't like people arguing about these things. I hope everyone can focus on the plot and talk more about the plot instead of these settings and attributes. I hope everyone can give more of their own ideas, understanding and opinions on the plot, which will be very helpful for Lao Lang's next creation.
